description: Flugplätze - Sicherheitszonen Land Salzburg is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by service.salzburg.gv.at. Digitalisation of aviation safety zones in the state of Salzburg. The Aviation Act, BGBL No 253/1957 provides information on provisions on aviation obstacles in security zones of an airport. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Airfields — Security Zones Land Salzburg" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Sicherheit, Luftverkehr, Flugverkehr, Flughafen, Verkehr. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XML, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/at/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
